displayTest.sharpnessSample: Clear, crisp text matters for long reading sessions. ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz 0123456789 The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. いろはにほへと ちりぬるを アイウエオ カキクケコ 简体中文：显示清晰锐利 繁體中文：顯示清晰銳利 한국어: 다람쥐 헌 쳇바퀴에 타고파
displayTest.testPattern.name: Test pattern
displayTest.testPattern.hint: Circles should be complete and round, frequency lines clear and defined, and color and gray gradients free of breaks or banding.
displayTest.black.name: Defective pixels on black
displayTest.black.hint: Look for stuck bright or colored pixels and light bleeding at the edges.
displayTest.white.name: Defective pixels on white
displayTest.white.hint: Look for dead dark or colored pixels.
displayTest.red.name: Defective pixels on red
displayTest.red.hint: Look for black or differently colored pixels on red.
displayTest.green.name: Defective pixels on green
displayTest.green.hint: Look for black or differently colored pixels on green.
displayTest.blue.name: Defective pixels on blue
displayTest.blue.hint: Look for black or differently colored pixels on blue.
displayTest.uniformity.name: Uniformity
displayTest.uniformity.hint: Brightness should be even across the screen, without colored areas or noticeable dark corners.
displayTest.colorDistance.name: Color distances
displayTest.colorDistance.hint: Pick a color and set the background brightness and the rectangle difference. The smaller the difference you can still see, the better the monitor separates similar colors.
displayTest.gradient.name: Gradients
displayTest.gradient.hint: View from a distance. At 256 steps the gradient should be smooth with no color cast; with fewer steps each band should be clearly distinct.
displayTest.sharpness.name: Sharpness
displayTest.sharpness.hint: Text should look crisp without shadows or color fringes, regardless of text smoothing.
displayTest.viewingAngle.name: Viewing angle
displayTest.viewingAngle.hint: Viewed from the side, above, and below, the circles should keep nearly the same color, brightness, and shape.
displayTest.gamma.name: Gamma
displayTest.gamma.hint: Move the slider until the center circle blends into the striped background as much as possible; the value shown is the monitor gamma (about 2.2 is typical).
displayTest.responseTime.name: Response time
displayTest.responseTime.hint: Pick a speed that shows clear streaks, then adjust the distance until the right square's streak no longer overlaps the left square. A smaller distance means a faster response.
keyboardTest.hint: Choose the keyboard layout and press every key. Pressed keys light up; tested keys stay marked.
mouseTest.area: Click, scroll, and move the mouse inside this area
mouseTest.hint: Double clicks on a single press usually mean a worn switch. With the trail on, gaps or jumps may mean a faulty mouse. Zoom responds to Ctrl + wheel. Keep moving quickly to estimate the polling rate.
mouseTest.chatter: Suspected double clicks (presses under 80 ms apart)
